baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَانُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا بَأْسَنَا (40:85 words 3-7)
baseline_models.mechanism: Benefit, heart-settling assent, direct perception, and overpowering force are temporally coupled: once force is present to sight, faith no longer performs the helping work encoded by ن ف ع.

activation_trace.role: Benefit as the contrary of harm supplies the efficacy being denied to faith.
Heart-settling assent supplies the disposition that would need to become operative, not merely verbal.
Direct perception marks the temporal condition under which the assent appears.
Overpowering severity supplies the coercive disclosure that removes uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: They believed when punishment appeared, but that belief was rejected.
changed_reading.after: Faith is treated as an efficacy-bearing disposition whose first appearance under coercive disclosure misses its operative interval.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ (40:85 words 8-14)
baseline_models.mechanism: A traversed path and the passing of earlier generations combine into a repeatable procedure moving through servants, rather than an isolated verdict invented for this scene.

activation_trace.role: A running path or followed course supplies the procedural shape of the divine sunna.
Passing generations supply the historical traversal already completed before the focus scene.
Submissive service supplies the recurring human relation within which the path operates.

changed_reading.before: This is God's customary rule inherited from the past.
changed_reading.after: The nonbenefit is one recurrence of a traversed route that has already run through earlier generations of servants.

baseline_models.mechanism: A covering posture can persist before exposure; at هُنَالِكَ it converts into realized deficit, with the trade branch of loss making the moment a settlement rather than a generic bad outcome.

activation_trace.role: Trade loss renders خسر as a realized deficit at a settlement point.
Covering supplies the posture that can defer recognition only before forced disclosure.

changed_reading.after: There marks the liquidation point where covering can no longer defer recognition and its accumulated deficit becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first presents turning as receivable and faith as an earlier summons within a call-and-answer relation. The focus therefore closes a previously open response interval at witnessed force; it does not make faith or return intrinsically useless.

activation_trace.role: Willing acceptance establishes that turning can be received rather than categorically barred.
The spoken call locates faith as an earlier summons that was refused.
Heart-settling assent is explicitly the object of that earlier call.
The imperative call keeps an addressable response channel open before judgment.
Answering speech supplies the promised reciprocity of the still-open channel.

structural_cues: 40:3 places acceptance of turning beside severe consequence; 40:10 retrospectively locates refusal at the earlier invitation; 40:60 offers call and answer before entry into punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an accepted-turning predicate and earlier call/response scenes; I infer a closing threshold at witnessed force, not an intrinsic defect in repentance. A live alternative is that sincerity, rather than timing alone, closes the channel.

changed_reading.before: Any faith associated with punishment cannot help.
changed_reading.after: What fails is faith initiated only after coercive manifestation, after an earlier receivable and answerable interval has been refused.

context_deltas.mechanism: The concealed believer's faith is already operative in a risky intervention before coercive evidence, whereas the group publicly speaks faith only after seeing force. Visibility of profession is therefore not the efficacy criterion; temporal freedom and enacted trust are.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies a faith that is real without prior public visibility.
Heart-settling assent names both the believer and the inward faith he conceals while acting.
Direct sight marks the coercive condition preceding the later public profession.
Overpowering severity removes the risk and uncertainty under which trust could operate.
The same assent vocabulary now appears as an explicit crisis declaration.

structural_cues: 40:28 calls the man a believer, states that he conceals his faith, and records his intervention; 40:84 records a group profession only after force is seen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed prior faith, costly intervention, and later coerced speech; I infer that operative trust under live risk matters more than audibility. A live alternative is that the two scenes distinguish persons rather than modes of faith.

changed_reading.before: Late faith fails because it was not professed earlier.
changed_reading.after: Faith can be hidden yet operative before coercion, while a loud profession after coercion can be nonbeneficial; publicity is not the axis.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the group covers when God alone is invoked and assents when association is admitted; after force is seen, it assents to God alone and disavows the former associates. The same vocabulary flips exactly when external incentives flip, making the crisis profession an emergency allegiance reversal.

activation_trace.role: Truth-blocking refusal appears when God alone is called.
Association with God supplies the condition under which their earlier assent appears.
Assent is shown as selective and aligned with the preferred shared arrangement.
Disavowal supplies their newly declared repudiation of the former associates.
Assent is reallocated to God alone only after the coercive reversal.

structural_cues: 40:12 and 40:84 form a polarity reversal: reject God-alone and accept association, then accept God-alone and reject association.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lexical chiasm and its changed circumstances; I infer an incentive-driven reversal rather than settled trust. A live alternative is a sincere conversion that remains independently too late.

changed_reading.after: Their confession reverses earlier selective allegiance only when coercive incentives reverse, so it reads as emergency reallocation rather than trust formed under choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly distinguishes being shown signs from returning, remembering, inward sight, faith, and action. The final seeing of force is therefore not first access to evidence but terminal undeniable visibility after failed recognition.

activation_trace.role: Caused showing establishes that signs were already made visible before the terminal scene.
Habitual return supplies the receptive movement linked to remembrance rather than bare exposure.
Settled assent belongs on the seeing side of the surah's moral contrast.
Heart-insight supplies a receptive kind of sight distinct from forced ocular disclosure.
Intentional action makes receptive faith operational rather than merely perceptual.
The opposite of recognition names the continuing response even after signs are shown.

structural_cues: 40:13 links prior showing to returning remembrance; 40:58 separates blindness from sight and pairs faith with work; 40:81 asks which already-shown signs are still denied.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated showing and a moral sight contrast; I infer a qualitative difference between receptive vision and forced perception. A live alternative is that the sight contrast remains classificatory without defining faith's timing.

changed_reading.before: They believe as soon as they finally see.
changed_reading.after: They had been shown signs already; what arrives in 40:84-85 is terminal undeniable perception after failed recognition, not the first opportunity to see.

context_deltas.mechanism: Commands to travel and examine earlier outcomes point to surviving traces, then the near-final repetition says accumulated earnings did not suffice. The focus sunna is thus an observable recurrence of failed efficacy, not an opaque rule disclosed only at the end.

activation_trace.role: Directed eye-and-insight examination makes the earlier outcome inspectable.
The last part and consequence supplies the historical endpoint readers are told to examine.
A remaining mark supplies material evidence that points back to what happened.
The repeated examination command reactivates the same historical test beside the focus.
Surviving traces again make former power visible without making it effective.
Failed sufficiency supplies a direct contextual analogue to denied benefit.
Sought gain and benefit supply the accumulated resource that nevertheless cannot suffice.

structural_cues: 40:21 and 40:82 repeat the same travel-look-outcome frame; the latter immediately adds that former earnings did not suffice, and 40:85 names the already-passed sunna.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrence, traces, and repeated efficacy failure; I infer a causal pedagogy in which the sunna could be recognized before terminal sight. The examples may evidence the rule without exhausting its cause.

changed_reading.after: The rule is an inspectable recurrence: prior power and accumulated earnings leave traces yet fail at the same consequence, so the pattern was visible before force became unavoidable.

context_deltas.mechanism: Followers ask leaders to suffice for them, all ranks are judged as servants, detainees appeal through keepers, and excuses do not benefit. The late profession in the focus becomes the last self-generated rescue instrument in a sequence where post-verdict benefit cannot be transferred or improvised.

activation_trace.role: Following behind another supplies the social dependency from which rescue is requested.
Sufficiency supplies the requested capacity of leaders to cover even a portion of the consequence.
Judgment between people closes the social transfer request with a settled ruling.
The servant relation levels leaders and followers under the same divine judgment.
A new appeal through the keepers continues the failed delegation of rescue.
Denied benefit explicitly classifies a post-verdict defense as ineffective.
The excuse supplies the failed defense whose nonbenefit anticipates the focus wording.

structural_cues: 40:47-52 forms a dialogue chain from followers to leaders, all servants under judgment, keepers, and finally a nonbenefiting excuse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive failed rescue channels; I infer that the 40:84 profession functions as the final self-generated appeal in that chain. A live alternative is that late faith is categorically different from social mediation and excuse.

changed_reading.after: The possessive their faith is the last in a chain of failed post-verdict transfers: leader, keeper, excuse, and finally crisis profession cannot substitute for prior response.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier near-final verse says that when God's command comes, judgment is executed in truth and the falsifiers lose there. The focus repeats خسر هنالك with the coverers, so there becomes the verdict hinge where latent falsehood is converted into settled loss.

activation_trace.role: Decisive judgment supplies the event that gives there its juridical force.
Stable reality against falsehood supplies the criterion enacted at the hinge.
General depletion supplies the exact repeated loss predicate.
Departure from truth and stability identifies what is exposed and liquidated there.

structural_cues: 40:78 has the sequence command arrives, judgment in truth, and خسر هنالك المبطلون; 40:85 repeats خسر هنالك with الكافرون.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the verbal and deictic match; I infer a shared adjudicative point where covering and falsification become realized loss. A live alternative is that هنالك only intensifies temporal location.

changed_reading.before: There means at the sight of punishment.
changed_reading.after: There is the verdict hinge: once truth is decisively executed, both falsification and covering are liquidated into realized loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people delight in the knowledge already with them until the reality they mocked descends and encloses them; only then do they see force and profess faith. Their faith follows the collapse of a self-authorizing epistemic posture rather than emerging while alternatives remain live.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the knowledge in which they treat themselves as already sufficient.
Descending enclosure supplies the collapse of that self-secured epistemic position.
Mockery names the prior stance toward the very reality that comes to enclose them.
Direct sight follows, rather than precedes, the collapse of their preferred account.
Assent appears only after rival epistemic confidence has become impossible to sustain.

structural_cues: 40:83 moves from delight in possessed knowledge to enclosure by what was mocked; 40:84 immediately moves from seeing force to professing faith.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate sequence; I infer epistemic capitulation after self-sufficient knowledge fails. A live alternative is that prior knowledge is merely one cause of rejection and the decisive defect remains timing alone.

changed_reading.before: They recognize truth when punishment confirms it.
changed_reading.after: Their faith follows the bankruptcy of self-sufficient knowledge and mockery; it is assent only after the rival epistemic posture becomes impossible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain transport reading is surprising because it links the adjacent livestock-and-ship utility field to faith. It remains anchored in يَنفَعُ and in packet roots at 40:80 for benefits, reaching need, ships, and carrying; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy, not a lexical equivalence.

activation_trace.role: Practical benefit anchors faith in an efficacy field.
Concrete benefits establish the nearby material utility side of the analogy.
Arrival at an endpoint supplies the successful delivery that crisis faith fails to achieve.
Urgent need supplies the desired end toward which conveyance is directed.
The ship supplies a concrete vehicle that crosses a medium toward an end.
Bearing a visible load supplies the carrying function transferred analogically to faith.

changed_reading.after: Faith is imagined as conveyance toward a needed end: unlike mounts and ships whose benefits carry and deliver, crisis faith cannot transport its holder across an already-reached boundary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because غ ف ر and ك ف ر deploy covering in morally opposite directions. It remains anchored in the focus coverers and faith-as-security, with the surah's protective covering of sin as contrast; downstream prose should label it a root-image inversion, not an etymological identity.

activation_trace.role: Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies a legitimate protective cover offered early.
The later request for protective covering keeps that route active before the terminal scene.
Self-covering supplies the posture that force finally strips of viability.
Security and trust supply the emergency shelter sought only after exposure.

changed_reading.before: The unbelievers try faith too late.
changed_reading.after: Those who spent the interval covering truth seek faith as emergency cover and security only after exposure; unlike offered forgiveness, this crisis covering cannot shield them from the consequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This form-sensitive reading is surprising because it hears the clipped يَكُ against the earlier كُن فَيَكُونُ and developmental sequence. It remains anchored in the focus ك و ن construction and packet timing roots; downstream prose should present it as a rhetorical echo, not a claim of direct grammatical dependence.

activation_trace.role: Negated occurrence in time anchors the failed becoming useful.
Becoming through ordered life stages supplies a sequence whose phases cannot simply be rearranged.
An appointed temporal limit supplies the boundary at which the sequence closes.
Completion and finalization supply the irreversible execution of an ordered matter.
Commanded occurrence supplies the positive becoming against which the focus negates useful becoming.

changed_reading.after: Negated useful becoming stands against divinely completed becoming: once the appointed sequence closes, crisis faith cannot issue a counter-command that reverses it.

strongest_changes: The focus closes an earlier open call-and-answer interval; force-seeing is terminal coercion, not first evidence.
The concealed but operative faith of 40:28 contrasts with the public crisis profession of 40:84, making publicity irrelevant to efficacy.
40:12 and 40:84 expose an allegiance reversal under changed incentives, while 40:83 makes the profession follow epistemic bankruptcy.
Repeated outcomes and traces, together with the exact 40:78 loss-there formula, turn sunna and there into an inspectable adjudicative recurrence.
The 40:47-52 rescue chain makes late faith the final failed post-verdict instrument rather than an isolated doctrinal statement.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet did more than add examples: it exposed temporal, epistemic, social, historical, and material mechanisms around the focus, especially concealed faith, repeated showing, failed proxy rescue, and the earlier خسر هنالك formula.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet leaves open how much nonbenefit is caused by lateness, coercion, insincerity, the accumulated prior posture, or their conjunction.
The transport field and the كُن فَيَكُونُ echo are visibly anchored but may be analogical activations rather than intended foreground mechanisms.
The inspectable recurrence supports the sunna but does not by itself determine whether its governing force is primarily causal, juridical, or both.
